hero.title: cookieheaven
hero.lede: I love the world, and I believe knowledge is its most powerful tool — the one treasure that grows when it is shared and teaches us how to see.
hero.quote: Knowledge is the most valuable thing we have because it cannot be diminished by being shared.
hero.cookieBusinesses: I am trying to save cookie businesses, too. Small good things deserve to survive.
hero.catAlt: Black pixel cat with green-yellow eyes holding a cookie
hero.worldQuote: “I’m usually loved by the world.” — Melissa, 2026

about.heading: A small doctrine
paragraphs: The world is stranger, larger, and more beautiful than it first appears. To learn is to keep meeting it again with better eyes.
Knowledge is not decoration. It is our most valuable asset: a way to name what is real, resist what is false, and become less easily ruled by fear.
This is a small archive of things I make, things I notice, and questions I refuse to stop asking.
